name: Eswatini Cars v1.1.0 — Staging + Production flavors (safe test-then-release workflow)
body:
## What's new in v1.1.0

This version introduces a **safe test-then-release workflow** so I never push broken code to production users again.

### The new workflow

**For website changes:**
1. I push to the `staging` branch (NOT main)
2. Vercel auto-creates a preview URL
3. You test the changes in the **EC [TEST]** app (a separate staging APK)
4. If good: I merge `staging` → `main` → production deploys → all users get it
5. If bad: I fix on `staging` → production users never saw the broken code

**For native (APK) changes:**
1. I build a staging APK + send you the download link
2. You install it alongside production (different app — 'EC [TEST]' with a yellow badge)
3. Test it
4. If good: I publish the production APK here for all users
5. If bad: no public release happened

### Two APKs from the same source code

| | Production (this release) | Staging (separate release) |
|---|---|---|
| Package | sz.co.eswatinicars.app | sz.co.eswatinicars.app.staging |
| App name | Eswatini Cars | EC [TEST] |
| Icon | Normal logo | Logo + yellow TEST badge |
| Loads | eswatini-cars.vercel.app | eswatini-cars-git-staging-...vercel.app |
| Coexists with prod? | — | YES (different package) |
| Download | (this release) | https://github.com/mlandvodlamini12-cloud/eswatini-cars/releases/tag/staging-v1.1.0 |

### Install

1. Uninstall v1.0.7 first (Settings → Apps → Eswatini Cars → Uninstall) — clears cached WebView state
2. Download the `Eswatini-Cars.apk` asset below
3. Open it (allow 'Install from unknown sources' if prompted)
4. Open Eswatini Cars from your app drawer

### Verification

- Package: sz.co.eswatinicars.app
- Version: 1.1.0 (versionCode 9)
- Size: 3.30 MB
- Signed with SHA-1 69:DF:80:0E:83:22:DA:59:60:1E:E7:3F:55:EC:ED:FB:2C:75:50:B8 (same key as v1.0.7 — Firebase + assetlinks.json unchanged)
- Icon: navy background with the Eswatini Cars logo (same as v1.0.7)
- Native bridge: window.Android.googleSignIn(), clearSession(), getAppVersion(), getEnvironment()

### Also install the TEST app for testing future changes

To test future changes before they hit production, install the staging APK too:
https://github.com/mlandvodlamini12-cloud/eswatini-cars/releases/tag/staging-v1.1.0

It installs ALONGSIDE this production app (different package name) — you'll have two app icons: 'Eswatini Cars' (production) and 'EC [TEST]' (staging).
